text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as Christmas was drawing near,
I was working in the trainer's office when...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Do Trainers not get presents from Santa Claus?
choice_data_list: Well... I am an adult, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I thought...
Even though Trainer is such a 'good girl'/'good kid'..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However... please don't worry.
This year, I'm thinking of giving out
presents in place of Santa...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Look forward to Christmas Day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of the event,
I went to the meeting spot Oguri Cap told me to go, and...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas.
Let us enjoy this day together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Mayano told me about this.
"An adult Christmas means going out in your racing silks."
...She taught me all sorts of other things, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
For instance—fun memories from an outing
can be a present in themselves for adults... and so on.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"So, please leave today's outing to me.
I want to give you the best present ever...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel a slight twinge of unease knowing she learned it
from Mayano Top Gun, but it's a gift she worked hard on.
I should just enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: For the order—I'll leave it up to you.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... Yes... Understood...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There we go...
Well, Trainer? Isn't your heart pounding...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mayano told me to keep the thrill in mind.
So I gave it some thought in my own way... and had an idea.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ――Leaving it to the chef means you never know what's coming, isn't that thrilling...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hamburg steak, curry, omurice...
Gratin or spaghetti... What could it be?
Ah, I can't wait... *drools*...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Look at this, a winter crab fair...
They all look so fresh and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course I like it, but I heard that looking at trendy things while shopping together is fun, so that's why I came.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: When it comes to the seasonal delicacy right now, it has to be crab, wouldn't you say?
choice_data_list: True, it does look delicious as a hot pot.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, hot pot... That would be supreme.
However, I will only look for now.
I was not advised to buy one, after all."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Just looking.
......Just looking, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, she treated me to several more escorts true to her style, and by the time I realized it, the sun had already completely set...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the illuminations have lit up.
It really feels just like Christmas...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we head over there soon?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's something special I want to show you at the end.
Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Alright, we're here!
choice_data_list: What are you going to do?
What are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The two of us are going to gaze at the stars.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Still, it's so beautiful.
The stars really are much clearer in the winter...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Back home, they taught me that the stars are especially clear at this time of year..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, the starry sky you can see from here
looks kind of like the one back in my hometown,
so looking at it puts me at ease..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
......Um... how was it?
Did you enjoy yourself...?
choice_data_list: I had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! 
It seems my intuition wasn't wrong."
choice_data_list: What idea did you come up with?
What did you come up with?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're an adult, so you probably
don't get presents from Santa, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I was agonizing over what to do about it.
Then Mayano told me that grown-ups have their own way of doing Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, an adult Christmas means
two close people spending the day together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's when it hit me.
Two people close to each other—that's literally us...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad my hunch was right...!
I hope it makes for a good present...
choice_data_list: This is the best present ever!
...Then maybe Santa won't be coming this year?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
! ...N-No way...
Did it surpass even Santa's present...!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing Santa Claus was something
I never even dreamed of... but it is... an honor.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Very well! In that case,
I shall inherit Santa's will from now on and deliver the presents myself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So I want you to look forward
to future Christmases too...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Gasp!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... Maybe Santa mistook me
for a grown-up...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you've got it wrong, Santa Claus...!
This is a present for my Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... That should be enough, but
maybe I should leave a letter by the pillow just in case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Oguri Cap happily
reported that the present she had written
in her letter was waiting by her pillow.
